name: CTASection
description: Full-width conversion band with eyebrow, headline, supporting copy and actions.
designIntent: Every marketing page ends with the same call-to-action band, but teams rebuild the padding, width and tone each time. CTASection standardizes the hierarchy and defaults to an inverse band.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline for the call to action.

examples.title: Default inverse CTA
examples.code:
<CTASection
  eyebrow="Join Axial"
  title="Join the network"
  description="Connect with counterparties and close transactions."
  actions={<Button>Get started</Button>}
/>
examples.description: A dark conversion band with one primary action.

examples.title: Muted CTA
examples.code: <CTASection tone="muted" align="left" title="Talk to an advisor" actions={<Button>Book a call</Button>} />
examples.description: A lighter band aligned to the page grid.

antiPatterns.title: Don't stack two CTA sections
antiPatterns.explanation: One conversion band per page is enough. Put secondary actions in the hero or footer.

accessibility.implementation: Renders an h2 so it sits under the page h1
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the title short and make the primary action the first control

accessibility.implementation: Section scopes inverse tokens for the band
accessibility.userRequirements: Use semantic button variants so contrast survives the tone

guidelines: Keep the supporting line to one sentence

compositionRules.relationship: CTASection renders Section internally; do not wrap it in another Section
Use one primary action and at most one secondary
